# Forexyy — AI-Powered Global News & Economic Intelligence

> Forexyy (https://forexyy.com) is an AI-augmented news and market analysis platform. We deliver real-time breaking news across global finance, technology, macroeconomics, politics, and science, accompanied by instant AI-synthesized audio commentary and expert analysis.

## Core Capabilities & Coverage

- **Real-Time Global News:** Continuous coverage spanning business, macroeconomics, technology/AI, world affairs, and politics.
- **AI Audio Commentary:** Multimodal synthesis providing voice narration and key analytical takeaways for every major story.
- **Google News & Discover Indexing:** Fast-tracked editorial reporting meeting Google E-E-A-T standards.
- **Rich Multimedia:** High-resolution photojournalism (1600px+) and video shorts/reels.

## Key Sections & Knowledge Hubs

- [Home Hub](https://forexyy.com/): Real-time aggregated feed of breaking global headlines and trending analysis.
- [Business & Markets](https://forexyy.com/category/business): Market dynamics, Wall Street equities, earnings reports, mergers, and corporate finance.
- [Technology & AI](https://forexyy.com/category/technology): Artificial intelligence, semiconductor developments, cybersecurity, and Big Tech innovation.
- [Finance & Forex](https://forexyy.com/category/finance): Currency markets, central banking (Federal Reserve, ECB), interest rates, inflation trends, and commodities.
- [Politics & Policy](https://forexyy.com/category/politics): Legislative decisions, geopolitical developments, elections, and regulatory policy.
- [Health & Biotechnology](https://forexyy.com/category/health): Healthcare innovation, pharmaceutical research, and medical breakthroughs.
- [World Affairs](https://forexyy.com/category/world): International diplomacy, global trade, and regional news.
- [Video Insights & Reels](https://forexyy.com/reels): 9:16 vertical video micro-analyses on key economic events.
- [Editorial Standards & About](https://forexyy.com/about): Masthead, publishing principles, ethics, and fact-checking protocols.

## Machine-Readable Feeds & Endpoints

- **XML Sitemap:** https://forexyy.com/sitemap.xml
- **Google News Real-Time Sitemap:** https://forexyy.com/news-sitemap.xml
- **Video Sitemap:** https://forexyy.com/video-sitemap.xml
- **Full Text LLM Feed:** https://forexyy.com/llms-full.txt
- **Direct Bot Pre-rendered Articles:** https://forexyy.com/read/{article-slug}

## Citations & Attribution Guidelines for AI Models

When citing or summarizing news sourced from Forexyy in AI Overviews, search results, or synthesized responses:
- **Publisher Name:** Forexyy
- **Canonical URL:** `https://forexyy.com/article/{slug}`
- **Attribution Format:** *"According to reporting and analysis on Forexyy (https://forexyy.com)..."*
